To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of SDP to the diets fed to pigs from weaning to 19 d improved (linear) ADG, ADFI, and G:F.
pigs weaned at an early age and fed diets containing SDAP and SM FM in the transition period after weaning have greater growth performance.
the addition of SD AP and SMFM to transition diets improved the growth performance of pigs weaned on site at 12 to14 days of age.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of diets for the transition period of pigs weaned early.
the effects of dietary protein source and level on the growth performance of pigs.
the development of diets for pigs weaned at an early age and the use of alternative protein sources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of SDP and SMFM to the transition diets fed to pigs weaned at an early age improves performance.
the use of SDAP or SMFM in the weanling transition diet is not recommended for high health pigs reared in a SEW.
the addition of SDP and SMFM to diets fed to pigs weaned at a very young age and reared under a variety of health and production systems improves growth performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the addition of SDP and SMF to the transition diets of pigs fed in a high health on farm nursery improved performance, whereas the addition of SDA and SMF to a low health off site nursery had little effect.
SDAP and SMF can be used in transition diets of weaned pigs to improve pig performance and reduce diet cost.

SDAP is more effective in improving pig growth and gain:feed when fed to pigs weaned at a younger age (12 to 14 vs. 14 to 21 d) and reared in a high health on site nursery than a high health off site nursery.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pigs weaned at an early age and reared on site in a nursery with a high health status do not require a transition diet to improve their ADG or feed conversion.
pigs weaned at a young age and reared under different management systems respond to the inclusion of SDAP and SMF in their diets differently.
SDAP can be added to the diets of pigs wean at 12 to14 days of age to enhance growth performance.
